_schema_note: Full-bleed three-quarter scene. Props name delivered sprites; anchors are fractions of the house rect so they hold as the house scales to the window.

violations.why: Unbordered weed growth in the front turf, visible from the street. No containment, no edging.
Second patch by the walk. Article VII 3(a) covers turf and paved joints alike.

decoys.why: Containers are at the curb, which R-104 restricts to Tue 6pm - Thu 9am. R-104 is NOT ACTIVE on Day 1, so this is not a violation today. It is the same picture that becomes one on Day 3, which is the point of showing it now.

notes_for_designer: The teaching lot. Two findings on the same article so the player learns R-101 covers the whole yard. Bins sit curbside deliberately: the object is established on Day 1 while it is harmless, so that when R-104 goes live the player recognises the sprite instead of meeting it cold.
